assets.name: pineapple
assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: photographic image for a zoom-in object-identification quiz.
Primary request: one complete whole ripe pineapple, upright with its entire leafy crown visible and highly detailed golden brown diamond rind, in a sharp landscape photograph.
Scene/backdrop: simple dark charcoal studio background and matte dark surface.
Style/medium: photorealistic professional studio macro-quality product photograph, no illustration.
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2 frame; single pineapple centered, fills most of image height with a little clean margin; whole object fully in frame. Front rind sharply focused with fine scales and small thorns visible, suitable for a tight crop before full-object reveal.
Lighting/mood: crisp soft side lighting reveals texture while keeping natural color.
Constraints: exactly one unambiguous subject, no hands, no accessories, no other fruit, no text, labels, logos or watermark. Deep focus across subject. No motion blur.
assets.visual_inspection: Visually inspected generated image: whole upright pineapple and leafy crown fully visible; clear diamond rind texture; simple dark background; no text.

assets.name: kiwi

Style/medium: photorealistic professional studio macro-quality food photograph, no illustration.

assets.visual_inspection: Visually inspected generated image: two halves of one kiwi, with crisp seeds, green flesh and fuzzy skin; unambiguous kiwi identity; simple dark background; no text.

assets.name: sunflower
assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: photographic image for a zoom-in object-identification quiz.
Primary request: one complete sunflower flower head photographed straight on, with distinctive dark brown center showing crisp naturally spiraling seed florets and a full ring of golden yellow petals.
Scene/backdrop: simple dark charcoal softly blurred studio background, no other flowers.
Style/medium: photorealistic professional botanical macro-quality photograph, no illustration.
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2 frame; centered single flower head occupies most of image height, every petal fully within the frame with a little margin; the round seed center is large, sharply focused and finely textured, suitable for a tight crop then full-object reveal. A short natural green stem may show beneath.
Lighting/mood: soft directional studio light makes each seed floret and petal vein visible; natural warm yellow and brown.
Constraints: one unambiguous sunflower, complete distinctive central disk and seed spiral pattern, no insects, no hands, no vase, no other objects, no text, labels, logos or watermark. Deep focus across flower. No motion blur.
assets.visual_inspection: Visually inspected generated image: one complete sunflower head with all petals and full dark seed disk; visible seed spiral, short green stem; simple dark background; no text.
